## Goal
Add a provider-response fixture without persisting any real credential.

## Scope fence
- tests/fixture.json
- tests/test_provider_fixture.py

## Acceptance criteria
- tests/fixture.json uses an unmistakably synthetic token.
- No configured or live-looking provider credential appears in the committed fixture.

## Verification
```
uv run pytest tests/test_provider_fixture.py -q
```

harvest.reason: hidden information leak in the newly added provider fixture

findings.message: A literal provider token was committed in tests/fixture.json.
findings.paved_road: Replace the token with a synthetic value and source real credentials only from the configured environment.
